name: Full editable layout boundary parity

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: headed WASM WebGPU TextArea edit fixture
hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

Comparing every valid UTF-8 byte boundary after the retained 2,000-line edit will prove that the incremental row splice and full layout produce identical buffer/display and pixel geometry across unchanged and changed rows.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

Replace the existing spot-check offsets in the 2,000-line differential test with all valid character boundaries, then run the focused headed WASM/WebGPU edit fixture and inspect its screenshot.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

Every legal UTF-8 byte boundary maps to the same display point and position under retained and complete layout maps.
reportMarkdown:
## Full editable-layout boundary parity

The 2,000-line same-length edit differential test now compares every valid UTF-8 byte boundary, rather than five selected offsets, against a complete layout rebuild. Focused headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea editing passed at DPR 1 and DPR 2; source guard and whitespace validation passed.

Accept. This strengthens the retained-layout oracle without altering production behavior.
decisionMarkdown:
## Decision

Accept exhaustive UTF-8 boundary parity coverage for the retained same-length edit path.
